subject.title: Feature Request: Automated Session Memory Preservation & Synthesis

question: Should OpenClaw core add automatic synthesized memory packages with transcript anchors on reset, or keep the bundled hook conservative and route richer memory retention to plugins/ClawHub until a core API gap is proven?
rationale: The central request changes how much transcript content OpenClaw preserves, summarizes, and rehydrates by default, which is a product/security choice rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep Core Conservative
options.body: Keep this as a design discussion and let narrower issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45608 handle specific pre-reset flush work.

options.title: Sponsor Core Synthesis
options.body: Define a bounded opt-in synthesis mode with privacy limits, transcript-link semantics, tests, and upgrade docs before implementation.

options.title: Canonical Plugin Path
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub memory, MCP, or plugin package that proves the workflow with current hook and memory surfaces before considering core promotion.

recommendation.title: Keep Core Conservative
recommendation.body: Keep this as a design discussion and let narrower issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45608 handle specific pre-reset flush work.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the internal hooks/session-memory surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether this behavior belongs in core.
